FINANCIAL INFORMATION ABOUT INDUSTRY SEGMENTS

We provide assisted and do-it-yourself (DIY) tax preparation solutions through multiple channels (including in-person, online and mobile applications, virtual, and desktop software) and distribute H&R Block-branded services and products, including those of our bank partners, to the general public primarily in the United States (U.S.), Canada and Australia. Tax returns are either prepared by H&R Block tax professionals in one of our company-owned or franchise offices, virtually or via an online review or prepared and filed by our clients through our DIY tax solutions. We also offer small business solutions through our company-owned and franchise offices (including in-person, online and virtual) and online through Wave®. We report a single segment that includes all of our continuing operations.

Assisted income tax return preparation and related services are provided by tax professionals via a system of retail offices operated directly by us or our franchisees. These tax professionals provide assistance to our clients either in person or virtually in a number of ways. Clients can come into an office, digitally "drop off" their documents for their tax professional, approve their return online, or have a tax professional review and sign a return they prepared themselves through Tax Pro Review®.

Our online software may be accessed through our website at www.hrblock.com or in a mobile application, while our desktop software may be purchased online and through third-party retail stores. Our generative AI powered technology, AI Tax Assist, and human help is offered to clients who prepare a paid DIY online return at no additional charge.

Assisted tax returns are covered by our 100% accuracy guarantee, whereby we will reimburse a client for penalties and interest attributable to an H&R Block error on a tax return. DIY tax returns are covered by our 100% accuracy guarantee, whereby we will reimburse a client (up to a maximum of $10,000 in the U.S.) if our software makes an arithmetic error that results in payment of penalties and/or interest to the respective taxing authority that the client would otherwise not have been required to pay.

We offer franchises as a way to expand our presence in certain geographic areas. In the U.S., our franchisees pay us approximately 30% of gross tax return preparation and related service revenues as a franchise royalty.

During fiscal year 2026, we also offered U.S. clients a number of additional services, including Refund Transfers (RT), our Peace of Mind® Extended Service Plan (POM), H&R Block Emerald Prepaid Mastercard® (Emerald Card®), SpruceSM, H&R Block Emerald Advance® (EA) term loans, Tax Identity Shield® (TIS), Refund Advance loans (RA), and small business financial solutions. For our Canadian clients, we also offer POM, H&R Block's Instant Refund®, H&R Block Pay With Refund®, and small business financial solutions.

Refund Transfers. RTs enable clients to receive their tax refunds by their chosen method of disbursement and include a feature enabling clients to authorize payment of their tax preparation and related fees from their tax refunds. Depending on circumstances, clients may choose to receive their RT funds by a load to their Emerald Card®, a deposit to their SpruceSM spending account, by receiving a check or by direct deposit to an existing account. RTs are available to U.S. clients and are frequently obtained by those who: (1) do not have bank accounts into which the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) can direct deposit their refunds; (2) like the convenience and benefits of a temporary bank account for receipt of their refund; and/or (3) prefer to have their tax preparation fees paid directly out of their refunds. RTs are offered through our relationship with our bank partner. We offer a similar program, H&R Block Pay With Refund®, to our Canadian clients through a Canadian chartered bank.

paragraphs: Our business activities expose us to a variety of risks. Identifying, monitoring, and managing these risks is essential to the success of our operations and the financial soundness of H&R Block. Senior management and the Board of Directors, acting as a whole and through its committees, take an active role in our risk management process and have delegated certain activities related to the oversight of risk management to the Company's enterprise risk management (ERM) team and the Enterprise Risk Committee, which is comprised of Senior Vice Presidents and Vice Presidents of major business and control functions and members of the ERM team. The Company's ERM team, working in coordination with the Enterprise Risk Committee, is responsible for identifying and monitoring risk exposures and related mitigation and leading the continued development of our risk management policies and practices.

An investment in our securities involves risk, including the risk that the value of that investment may decline or that returns on that investment may fall below expectations. There are a number of factors that could cause actual conditions, events, or results to differ materially from those described in forward-looking statements, many of which are beyond management's control or its ability to accurately estimate or predict, or that could adversely affect our financial position, results of operations, cash flows, and the value of an investment in our securities. These disclosures reflect the Company's beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect the Company and its securities in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future. The risks described below are not the only ones we face. We could also be affected by other events, factors, or uncertainties that are presently unknown to us or that we do not currently consider to be significant risks to our business. These risks may be exacerbated by the effects of local, national, and global conditions or events, including macroeconomic, political, geopolitical, or public health conditions or events, which may cause significant instability.

Changes in applicable tax laws have had, and may in the future have, a negative impact on the demand for and pricing of our services. Government changes in tax filing or IRS processes may adversely affect our business and our consolidated financial position, results of operations, and cash flows.

The U.S. government has in the past made, and may in the future make, changes to the income tax provisions of the Internal Revenue Code, tax regulations, and the rules and procedures for implementing such laws and regulations. In addition, taxing authorities or other relevant governing bodies in various federal, state, local, and foreign jurisdictions in which we operate may change the income tax laws in their respective jurisdictions, including the elimination of income taxes in certain cases, and such laws may vary greatly across the various jurisdictions. It is difficult to predict the manner in which future changes to the Internal Revenue Code, tax regulations, and the rules and procedures for implementing such laws and regulations, and state, local, and foreign tax laws may impact us and the tax return preparation industry. Such future changes could decrease the demand or the amount we charge for our services, and, in turn, have a material adverse effect on our business and our consolidated financial position, results of operations, and cash flows.

In addition, taxing authorities in various federal, state, local, and foreign jurisdictions in which we operate have introduced measures seeking to simplify or otherwise modify the preparation and filing of tax returns or the issuance of refunds in their respective jurisdictions. For example, from time to time, U.S. federal and state governments have considered various proposals through which the respective governmental taxing authorities would use taxpayer information provided by employers, financial institutions, and other payers to "pre-populate," prepare, and calculate tax returns and distribute them to taxpayers. There are various initiatives from time to time seeking to expedite, reduce, or change the timing of refunds, which could reduce the demand for certain of our services or financial products.

The adoption or expansion of any measures that significantly simplify tax return preparation, or otherwise reduce or eliminate the need for third-party tax return preparation services or financial products, including governmental encroachment at the U.S. federal and state levels, as well as in foreign jurisdictions, could reduce demand for our services and products and could have a material adverse effect on our business and our consolidated financial position, results of operations and cash flows.

A summary of our fiscal year 2026 results is as follows:

•Revenue increased $184.4 million, or 4.9%, largely due to increases in U.S. company-owned net average charge and tax return volume. International revenues increased due to favorable foreign currency exchange rates in Canada and Australia, and Wave® revenues increased as a result of higher subscription revenue and payments volume. These increases were partially offset by lower U.S. royalties revenue due to lower franchise tax return volumes, which was primarily driven by franchise acquisitions. During the year we purchased franchise offices which resulted in increasing tax preparation revenues and decreasing royalties as the revenues and returns become company-owned after the acquisition.
•Operating expenses increased $104.7 million, or 3.6%, due to higher compensation and benefits, occupancy, and technology costs.
•Pretax income increased $72.5 million, or 9.3%.

•Income tax expense decreased $54.4 million, or 31.6%, primarily due to the settlement of an IRS examination of our 2020 U.S. federal income tax return and related carryback claims to the 2015 through 2018 tax years.
•Net income from continuing operations of $736.3 million increased 20.8% from the prior year.
•EBITDA(1) of $1,056.9 million increased $80.6 million, or 8.3%.

產業部門之財務資訊

我們透過多種通路（包括親臨現場、線上及行動應用程式、虛擬及桌面軟體）提供協助完成（assisted）及自行處理（do-it-yourself, DIY）的稅務準備解決方案，並向一般大眾（主要為美國（U.S.）、加拿大及澳洲）提供 H&R Block 品牌的服務與產品，包括與我們銀行合作夥伴的服務與產品。稅務申報單由 H&R Block 稅務專業人員在本公司自有或特許經營據點、透過虛擬方式或線上審查準備及提交，或由客戶透過我們的 DIY 稅務解決方案自行準備及提交。我們亦透過本公司自有及特許經營據點（包括親臨現場、線上及虛擬方式）及線上 Wave® 提供中小企業解決方案。我們報告一個應報告分部，包含所有持續經營業務。
協助辦理稅務申報及相關服務由稅務專業人員透過零售據點系統提供，這些據點由本公司或經銷商直接經營。這些稅務專業人員以多種方式協助客戶，包括親自到現場或透過遠距方式。客戶可至據點現場，透過數位方式將文件交給稅務專業人員，線上審核其申報表，或讓稅務專業人員審核並簽署客戶自行準備的申報表，透過 Tax Pro Review® 進行審核。
我們的線上軟體可透過本公司網站 www.hrblock.com 或行動應用程式存取，而桌面軟體則可線上購買或透過第三方零售商店購買。我們的生成式 AI 技術 AI Tax Assist 與人為協助服務，對準備並支付費用的 DIY 網路申報客戶提供免費服務。
協助辦理的稅務申報表受本公司 100% 精確保證覆蓋，若因本公司錯誤導致稅務申報表產生罰款與利息，我們將賠償客戶相關費用。DIY 稅務申報表亦受 100% 精確保證覆蓋，若因我們軟體的計算錯誤導致客戶需向相關稅務機關支付罰款與/或利息，我們將賠償客戶（美國客戶最高賠償金額為 10,000 美元）。
我們透過經銷模式擴展在特定地理區域的業務。在美國，經銷商需支付我們約 30% 的稅務申報及相關服務收入作為經銷權費用。

在財務年度 2026 年，我們也為美國客戶提供多項附加服務，包括退款轉移（RT）、我們的安心保障® 延長服務方案（POM）、H&R Block Emerald 預付 Mastercard®（Emerald 卡®）、SpruceSM、H&R Block Emerald 提前貸款®（EA）期貨貸款、稅務身分保護®（TIS）、退款貸款（RA）以及小型企業財務解決方案。對於加拿大客戶，我們也提供 POM、H&R Block 即時退款®、H&R Block 以退款付款® 以及小型企業財務解決方案。

退款轉移。RT 服務讓客戶能選擇其偏好的退款發放方式，並包含讓客戶授權從其稅務退款中支付稅務申報及相關費用的功能。根據情況，客戶可選擇透過載入至 Emerald 卡®、存入 SpruceSM 花費帳戶、取得現金支票或直接存入現有帳戶的方式接收 RT 金額。RT 服務對美國客戶開放，常被以下人士使用：(1) 沒有銀行帳戶可供美國國稅局（IRS）直接存入退款；(2) 偏好擁有臨時銀行帳戶以接收退款的便利與好處；以及/或 (3) 希望直接從退款中支付稅務申報費用。RT 服務透過我們與銀行合作夥伴的關係提供。我們也為加拿大客戶提供類似方案，H&R Block 以退款付款®，透過加拿大授權銀行提供。

財務年度 2026 年的摘要結果如下：

•營業收入增加 1.844 億美元，或 4.9%，主要由於美國公司自有淨平均收費及稅務申報量增加。國際收入增加係因加拿大及澳洲有利的外幣交換率，以及 Wave® 收入因訂閱收入及付款量增加所致。這些增加部分抵銷了美國特許經營 royalties 收入因特許經營稅務申報量減少而下降，主要由於特許經營收購所致。在本年度，我們購入特許經營辦公室，導致稅務準備收入增加及 royalties 減少，因收入及申報在收購後成為本公司自有。
•營運費用增加 1.047 億美元，或 3.6%，係因薪資及福利、營運及科技費用增加所致。

paragraphs: 本公司業務活動使我們面臨多種風險。辨識、監測與管理這些風險對我們營運的成功與 H&R Block 的財務健全至關重要。高階管理階層與董事會透過整體及各委員會的行動，積極參與我們的風險管理程序，並已委派某些與風險管理監督相關的活動給本公司企業風險管理（ERM）團隊與企業風險委員會，該委員會由主要業務與控制功能的高階副總裁與副總裁，以及 ERM 團隊成員組成。本公司 ERM 團隊與企業風險委員會協調合作，負責辨識與監測風險敞口及相關緩衝措施，並領導我們風險管理政策與作法的持續發展。

投資本公司證券涉及風險，包括投資價值可能下跌，或投資回報可能低於預期。許多因素可能導致實際情況、事件或結果與向前看聲明中所述有重大差異，其中許多因素超出管理階層的控制範圍，或其準確預測或估計的能力，或可能對我們的財務狀況、營運結果、現金流及投資本公司證券的價值造成不利影響。這些披露反映本公司對可能對本公司及其證券未來造成重大且不利影響的因素的信念與觀點。對過往事件的提及僅為示例，並非完整清單，也不表示這些因素是否已發生過或其未來發生的可能性。
適用稅法的變更已對我們服務的 demand 與 pricing 產生負面影響，並可能在未來繼續產生負面影響。政府對稅務申報或 IRS 流程的變更可能對我們業務與我們的合併財務狀況、營運結果與現金流造成不利影響。

美國政府過去曾對內政部稅收條款進行變更，並可能在未來繼續進行變更。此外，在我們營運的各個聯邦、州、地方及外國司法管轄區，稅務當局或其他相關主管機關可能變更其轄區的所得稅法，包括在某些情況下取消所得稅，而這些法律可能在各個司法管轄區之間差異極大。預測未來對內政部稅收條款、稅務規則及實施這些法律與規則的程序，以及州、地方及外國稅法的變更，如何影響我們與稅務申報產業，是非常困難的。這些未來變更可能減少我們服務的 demand 或我們收取的費用，進而對我們業務與我們的合併財務狀況、營運結果與現金流產生重大不利影響。

此外，在我們營運的各個聯邦、州、地方及外國司法管轄區，稅務當局已推出措施，旨在簡化或以其他方式修改稅務申報與申報的流程，或在各自轄區內發放退款。例如，美國聯邦與州政府有時會考慮各種提案，使相關政府稅務當局利用僱主、金融機構及其他付款人提供的納稅人資訊，以「預填」、準備並計算稅務申報表，並將其分發給納稅人。有時也會推出各種措施，以加速、減少或改變退款的時間，這可能會減少我們某些服務或金融產品的需求。
任何大幅簡化稅務申報流程的措施，或以其他方式減少或消除第三方稅務申報服務或金融產品需求的措施，包括美國聯邦與州政府，以及外國司法管轄區的政府介入，都可能減少我們服務與產品的需求，並可能對我們業務與我們的合併財務狀況、營運結果與現金流產生重大不利影響。
